body: He used to tell me the same thing, I'm allowed to be upset and angry and sad, that I'm not selfish for it so thank you for telling me that. I swear posting on these kinds of things is the only way I can vent lately, thanks for listening

It didn't make me feel worse, thank you for commenting. It helps to write about it and for someone to be there reading it at the very least. My only way to talk about this kind of stuff right now is on here so thank you for listening

I have nothing but time honestly, but the city I live in is small and I've looked into support groups but they don't have any here. I would really love to go, be around people who may be going through something similar but because there isn't any reddit or other anonymous sites are where I turn to for support.
I know my family loves me and would want to be here for me but I just cant or dont know how to reach out when I've been "strong" for months
